```bash
     -H "x-apikey: pp_key123"
```

```json
{
    "data": [
        {"id":"a.paypal.com","attributes":{"last_analysis_stats":{"harmless":10,"malicious":0}}},

        ...

    "links": {
        "self":"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v2/domains/paypal.com/sub-domains",

    "meta": {
        "total_count": 120,
        "page_number": 1,
        "per_page": 25
    }
}
```

Replace `<new_cursor>` with the value returned in the `"next"` link’s `cursor` parameter (`pp_next`) to paginate further.
